title: Bongaigaon
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Bongaigaon is a town and district in western Assam, known for its oil refinery and as a commercial and railway hub.

Industry

The Bongaigaon Refinery (now part of Indian Oil) processes crude oil from Assam's fields, and the town grew around the refinery, railways and trade.

Nearby

The district lies near the Manas National Park and the Bhutan foothills, and its markets serve the surrounding agricultural districts.
